subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw solve the stranded `message_tool_only` final issue with this PR's default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config, or with the newer no-new-config recovery direction after that branch is refreshed?
rationale: Both branches address the same message-loss class but make different product and privacy-boundary choices, and the successor PR is open but currently conflicting rather than a safe replacement.

options.title: Choose canonical policy first
options.body: Pick the intended recovery policy, then require real external-transport proof on the chosen branch before merge.

options.title: Proceed with opt-in config
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if maintainers explicitly approve the new root config option and the contributor adds real transport proof.

options.title: Pause for successor refresh
options.body: If default recovery without a new config surface is preferred, wait for the successor branch to become clean before closing this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical policy first
recommendation.body: Pick the intended recovery policy, then require real external-transport proof on the chosen branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans core config, auto-reply delivery, and the privacy policy established by the warning-only predecessor where this handle is the strongest rewrite/merge signal.
